answer: The harbor holds work receipts rather than names, so the mirror of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. By the sonnet of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
